title: Fixed-witness normalized vector scalar compatibility
statement: Given normalized vector purity families over finite coefficient rings, a normalized Tate-line comparison, and invertible components of both families, the prescribed scalar source, compact-support map, mate map and counit compatibility clauses hold for every constructible finite-Tor input or the coefficient unit.

source.place: paragraph 2, normalized transpose and assembly step 5

proof.text: Apply the split-off source-map compatibility theorem to obtain invertibility of the prescribed source map and the normalized purity-family equation.

Use compact-support scalar coherence for invertibility of the compact-support map; combine the source equation with invertibility of the source and purity components and cancel the scalar purity component to obtain invertibility of the mate.
